pr_body:
Changing the CONF_TYPE_FLAG was a bad idea because mpv_node.u.flag
continues to be an int, leading to a mismatch in type sizes which can
lead to problems with memcpy().

Closes #11373
pr_comments:
One last thing:
> Partially revert "options: transition properties from flag to bool"

while technically true it's just changing 3 lines around, I would use a different commit message

> options: forgotten parameter change in property transition commit

also there's no verb in this message
Should be `client API:` (lowercase). I'm not sure if we really have a rule for capitalization on revert commits but I guess "Partially revert" is fine since "Revert" is commonly used.

issue_context.title: API regression/breakage
issue_context.body:
since 17d91b9d4d2d208f4a847395198cdbbcad18de93, ping @christoph-heinrich 

example code from client.h:
```c
int flag = 1;
mpv_set_property(ctx, "property", MPV_FORMAT_FLAG, &flag);
```

setproperty_fn copies the bytes:
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1042418/221367475-b078ace9-5a02-4760-8101-e1f2e843b256.png)

since `MPV_FORMAT_FLAG` now maps to `CONF_TYPE_BOOL` this copies 1 byte:
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1042418/221367511-a5bd8eaa-5d32-4f61-aa28-41aaeff90551.png)

but an int is bigger than 1 byte, so you get mpv acting upon incorrect/unitialized data

`mpv_get_property` presumably has the same issue
comments:
Maybe just?
```
diff --git a/options/m_option.c b/options/m_option.c
index 61b75ec14a..86a1c4c577 100644
--- a/options/m_option.c
+++ b/options/m_option.c
@@ -211,7 +211,7 @@ static bool bool_equal(const m_option_t *opt, void *a, void *b)
 
 const m_option_type_t m_option_type_bool = {
     .name  = "Flag", // same as m_option_type_flag; transparent to user
-    .size  = sizeof(bool),
+    .size  = MPMAX(sizeof(bool), sizeof(int)),
     .flags = M_OPT_TYPE_OPTIONAL_PARAM | M_OPT_TYPE_CHOICE,
     .parse = parse_bool,
     .print = print_bool,
```

I don't think `mpv_get_property` or `mpv_set_property` are going to not do memcpy any time soon.
Wouldn't this potentially read unitialized memory from the callers pointer?

No, but it's almost guaranteed to cause issues elsewhere when a real bool is used but size is bigger than it.

As far as I can tell it would suffice to fix the type conversion in `player/client.c` with no bigger implications.

I think `m_property_bool_ro()` in m_property also needs to be adjusted. I'm trying to track down all the places where this discrepancy in types might matter, but with data getting passed around as `void *` it's not easy.
I thought my suggestion was stupid because you could end up copying too much memory.

From what I've seen so far the type should always be a `m_option_value` or `mpv_node` union, both of which are big enough that touching those additional bytes would be fine, but it might lead to accidentally overwriting (or reading) too much memory at some point in the future.

I guess the safest way forward would be to revert 17d91b9d4d2d208f4a847395198cdbbcad18de93 and 07545657bf73ebb4da38e26950d5203466298ec1

Edit: Found a place where there is a bool on the stack and it uses that as destination, which is not safe with the potentially bigger size. Let's revert it and be done with it. I'd like to keep the `OPT_FLAG` macro removed though.

review_comments: Should you also change the cast below to bool?
Yes, that looks like another memory error :thinking:
minor nit: Given that `var` is now a proper `bool` the `!!` is redundant.
I *think* you could leave the option changes, we just need `CONF_TYPE_FLAG` back for the sake of conversion
might also be worth pointing out somewhere that this only still exists for libmpv interopability and should not be used anywhere
